source_preview:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title: Video Editor
Location: Vikhroli, Mumbai
Job Summary:
We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor to join our team.
The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of video production,
including editing, motion graphics, and sound design. You will work closely with
our production team to create engaging videos for various platforms, including
social media, marketing, and internal communications.
Key Responsibilities:
• Edit raw video footage into polished final products that meet the creative
direction and specifications.
• Add graphics, music, sound effects, and voiceovers to enhance the
overall quality of the video.
• Ensure video content is optimized for different platforms (e.g., social
media, website, YouTube, etc.).
• Review and edit videos based on feedback, ensuring high-quality
standards are met.
• Manage and organize video files and assets for easy retrieval and editing.
• Keep up with industry trends and best practices in video editing, and
incorporate new techniques as appropriate.

Education
• Proven experience as a video editor or similar role.
• Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final
Cut Pro, or other industry-standard tools.
• Experience with motion graphics and animation (Adobe After Effects or
similar is a plus).
• Strong understanding of video formats, aspect ratios, and optimization
for different platforms.
